title: Full-Stack Engineer (Back-End Leaning)
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for back-end engineers to expand the functionality of our system. There is flexibility in staffing engineers on projects across the company, depending on the project, your specific responsibilities might include:  

- Building and maintaining our platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which are used by millions of users.

- Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

- Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

- Collaborating closely with engineers and others from the Frontend, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for our customers.

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

- Expertise in Python.

title: Creative Producer
description:

At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

This role leads photo and video production across Hasbro Content Creation Studios, leads assistant producers, and serves as the Senior Studio Manager’s operational partner. Working with the Shenzhen Photo and Video Studio and Hong Kong 3D and AI Studio, this role aligns priorities, workflows, and delivery across global teams and external partners.

The Creative Producer oversees seasonal assets from product development through consumer-facing creative. Partnering with Digital Shelf, Creative Operations, Marketing, and Brand Design, they turn creative direction into work that is on time, on brand, and within budget while embracing new tools and digital-first ways of working.

This is a hybrid position will be onsite Tuesday-Thursday at Hasbro's Lincoln, RI office location.

A Day in the Life as a Creative Producer:
Team Leadership and Studio Operations
• Lead, mentor, and support associate producers and interns through clear expectations, regular feedback, and professional development.

Creative Production and Project Management

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions. 
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team. 
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance. 
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits such as health insurance and retirement plans. 
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success. 
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth. 
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team. 

About Caseware:
Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.

With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.

One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at talent@caseware.com.

AI Usage:
The recruitment process may use AI assisted tools but not for candidate screening or assessment. All final hiring decisions are made by humans to ensure fairness, transparency, and oversight. 

Background Check:
Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co 

Security and Fraud:
Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website https://jobs.lever.co/caseware. We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. If you receive an unsolicited job offer, proceed with extreme caution.

title: FNOL Claims Handler
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

First Notification of Loss is the first thing a customer experiences after an accident, and it sets the tone for everything that follows. In 18 months, every Zego customer reporting a loss will get an accurate, empathetic first contact and be routed to the right next step first time. You are the reason claims start clean, so the rest of the journey runs smoothly.

What you will be doing

- Handle First Notification of Loss queries by phone, email and live chat with empathy, accuracy and efficiency.

- Capture every relevant claim detail correctly at first contact, so nothing has to be chased again later.

- Triage customers and route them to the right next step in their claims journey.

- Leave customers feeling heard, supported and informed at a genuinely difficult moment.

- Keep records in our claims management systems accurate, protecting data quality at every stage.

- Work with the wider Claims team and supply chain partners so claims progress smoothly from the very first touchpoint.

What you will need to be successful

- Call centre experience. You have worked in a call centre and in a fast paced environment. Insurance experience is not required.

- Empathy under pressure. You communicate with clarity and warmth, especially when customers are in distress.

- An eye for detail. You get the facts right and build rapport quickly over the phone.

- Prioritisation at volume. You can multitask, set priorities and manage your time in a high volume contact centre.

- Shift availability. 37.5 hours a week, five days out of seven, on shifts between 8am and 6pm Monday to Sunday. That normally means one weekend a month.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

THE ZEGO WAYS OF WORKING 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKOYDx6AMxQ.

BENEFITS 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance, for you

title: Advanced Technology & Innovation Leader – Medical Imaging
description:
Job Title
Advanced Technology & Innovation Leader - Medical Imaging Job Description
Advanced Technology & Innovation Leader - Medical Imaging
The Advanced Technology & Innovation Leader drives the discovery and commercialization of emerging technologies, combining deep technical expertise with hands-on leadership to create the next generation of medical imaging solutions. By leading a small innovation team and collaborating closely with R&D, Product Management, Clinical, and Business leaders, this role transforms cutting-edge ideas into market-ready products that deliver clinical and business impact.
Your role:

• Lead the development and execution of the Advanced Technology & Innovation roadmap, aligning innovation initiatives with business and clinical priorities. Serve as a senior technical advisor on innovation strategy and future technology investments.

• Identify, evaluate, and advance emerging technologies to create competitive differentiation, with a focus on AI, advanced algorithms, imaging, biomedical optics, computational modeling, and data-driven solutions. Drive innovation from concept and feasibility through product development and commercialization.

• Provide technical leadership for strategic technology platforms and product initiatives. Contribute directly to complex technical challenges, including prototyping, algorithm development, system design, and the transition of technologies into regulated medical devices.

• Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary Advanced Technology team while fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and rapid experimentation. Recruit and develop top engineering and scientific talent and leveraged global capabilities and external partnerships.

• Partner with Intellectual Property teams to identify, protect, and promote key innovations through invention disclosures and patent development. Contribute to technology landscape assessments that informed innovation and investment strategies.

You're the right fit if:

• You bring extensive experience developing innovative medical device and/or medical imaging technologies and have demonstrated success translating research and innovation into commercial products. You are an experienced people leader with a proven track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• You have deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: AI/Machine Learning, Medical Imaging, Biomedical Optics, Advanced Algorithms, and Computational Modeling. Bonus qualifications include a strong record of technical leadership, innovation, and intellectual property development.

• You hold a PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field. A Master’s degree with significant relevant industry experience will also be considered.

• You demonstrate excellent communication and collaboration skills and can effectively partner across technical, clinical, and business organizations to drive innovation and business impact.

• You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.

title: Women's Mental Health Therapist - New Jersey
description:
Therapist - Women’s Mental Health (NJ)
Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact in women’s mental health care? Here's your chance to be a vital part of FamilyWell's mission to enhance access to high-quality, equitable, and affordable mental health services for pregnant, postpartum, and menopausal individuals across the U.S.
Background:
FamilyWell Health is an AI-enabled mental health start-up dedicated to solving the women’s mental health crisis by seamlessly embedding high quality, equitable, & affordable mental health care into OB/Gyn practices. FamilyWell provides comprehensive virtual mental health services designed specifically for integration into OB/Gyn and Family Medicine practices utilizing the psychiatric collaborative care model. FamilyWell’s virtual care team model delivers evidence-based coaching, therapy, care coordination, and psychiatric services with specialized expertise in perinatal mental health and perimenopause/menopause. For more information: .
Role:

Location : Remote Department: Care Operations Job type: Part-time, 10-30 hours per week as a 1099/contractor Compensation: $80 per 60-minute session (inclusive of intake and follow-up) plus 2-hour allotment per month for administrative compensation
Patient Care & Support Responsibilities:

• Provide individual tele-therapy to patients requesting regular sessions using FamilyWell’s virtual platform.

• Conduct one-on-one psychological intakes for referred FamilyWell program patients, gathering comprehensive assessments to inform treatment planning.

• Document patient progress comprehensively, sharing treatment recommendations with medical providers, psychiatric consultants, and other treating professionals as needed.
Facilitate treatment plan modifications for patients needing more intensive or specialized mental health care, ensuring timely and appropriate interventions.

• Develop and deliver Care Plans post-session, offering patients actionable insights and follow-up steps.

Qualifications:

• Licensed mental health provider who holds an active license in New Jersey. All applicants must be able to practice independently / without supervision.
Licensures that qualify include the following :

• Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)

• Licensed Marriage Family Therapist (LMFT)

• Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)

Experience:

• Formal perinatal/peri/menopause mental health training or a minimum of 1 year of clinical experience working with pregnant and/or postpartum and/or peri/menopause patients is strongly preferred.
Preferred Certification:

• Perinatal Mental Health Certification (PMH-C) from Postpartum Support International is recommended but not required.

• Proof of certification in the treatment of the Peri/Menopause population is recommended but not required.

Skills & Attributes:

• Passionate and driven to improve women’s mental healthcare delivery, especially for vulnerable patient populations.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams.

• Commitment to patient-centered care and innovative mental health solutions.

• Proficiency with tele-therapy platforms and virtual care delivery.

Please be aware of recruitment scams. FamilyWell will never ask candidates to pay money, request sensitive personal information early in the process, or conduct interviews over unsecured platforms. All official communication will come from an @ email address.

title: SharePoint Online (SPO) & SharePoint SE Tier II Support Technician
description:
The SPO & SharePoint SE Tier II Support Technician provides critical technical support, light administration, and troubleshooting for SharePoint Online (SPO) and SharePoint Subscription Edition (SE) environments. Designed for a motivated, well-rounded junior technician or developer eager to dig deep into legacy on-premises architecture and modern cloud environments, this role requires a tenacious problem solver who thrives in a solution-oriented, highly resourceful team culture-thoroughly investigating, researching, and testing all potential pathways to resolve issues independently before escalating to Tier III or engineering. This position seamlessly blends troubleshooting with light administrative and customer-facing support, offering a strong pathway for technical growth within the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform ecosystems.
Responsibilities:
Tier II Technical Support & Administration

• Diligently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Tier II issues related to SharePoint architecture, site collections, permissions, broken web parts, hardcoded links, lists/libraries, and access control.

• Demonstrate a rigorous, investigative approach by researching technical documentation, analyzing logs, and replicating problems in test environments before considering escalation to Tier III or IV.

• Perform essential, light administrative tasks such as processing site URL changes, managing user account configurations, and recovering deleted sites, lists, or content.

• Provide basic troubleshooting and assistance for customer Power Automate flows, Power Apps forms, and Power BI reports to resolve functional blockages and issues.

• Manage help desk ticket queues (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy) within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), ensuring clear, detailed documentation of all troubleshooting steps taken.

Training & User Support

• Provide friendly, customer-focused guidance to site owners, content managers, and end-users on SharePoint governance, permissions best practices, and feature usage.

• Provide occasional Tier I basic support to redirect misrouted tickets and quickly resolve minor end-user errors.

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain and update internal knowledge bases, technical guides, scripts, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to facilitate team knowledge sharing.

• Provide regular status updates on active tickets and assigned tasks, proactively highlighting progress, risks, or potential operational blockers.

Qualifications:

•

•

•

title: Ads & Promotions Manager
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

The Ads & Promotions Manager is responsible for driving Sponsored Listings revenue growth by leading and developing the local Ad Sales team and working closely with Account Management. 

What you’ll be doing

The role owns performance against key country targets, including Venue Penetration, Ad Load, and Sponsored Listings revenue. It translates cluster-level Ads & Promos objectives into clear team and individual goals, ensuring strong execution through coaching, pipeline management, and regular performance tracking. As the key link between frontline Account Managers and the Cluster Ads & Promos Lead, the manager identifies business risks and growth opportunities, supports cross-functional alignment, and builds a high-performing, accountable team.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Manage and grow a personal portfolio of merchant partners by selling and optimising Sponsored Listings and promotional solutions, while delivering agreed revenue and growth targets.

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Ad Sales Specialists, each managing their own portfolio of merchant partners.

• Set clear individual and team goals, monitor progress, and support the team in building strong pipelines and prioritising the highest-potential opportunities.

• Balance hands-on sales execution in the personal portfolio with effective people management, coaching, and removing blockers for the team.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general track for first-level engineering management positions at Canonical .
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable, and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. They are trusted engineers who understand the importance of a whole-team effort in creating great products and who enjoy seeing colleagues develop. They should contribute code themselves to set the standard for coding, but know that the code they write is far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus, and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers who are interested in soft skills to be managers.
A typical first-level software engineering team is based in a single time zone, such as EMEA or Americas, or APAC, with an Engineering Manager and a Senior Engineer dedicated to a single product, who work as a team to shape the roadmap, technical strategy, code, documentation, and community engagement. They are both capable of coding, and are both leaders comfortable assigning work and maintaining expectations of delivery. They will both be expected to take management training at Canonical so they speak the same language when it comes to team behaviours, habits, routines, norms, and standards, but they focus on different sides of the problem.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
We have open manager roles across a wide range of engineering domains, including:

• Distro packaging and systems

This role is responsible for modeling member-level physical and mental health trajectories, identifying the clinical and operational drivers behind HOS measure performance, and translating those insights into targeted interventions that move specific Star Rating cut points.
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, clinical outcomes, and survey methodology - directly shaping the strategy behind one of the most influential and least understood components of the Star Ratings program. GENERAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Model statistical significance and year-over-year variance to distinguish genuine performance shifts from survey noise or sampling error.

• Coordinate with HOS survey vendors on cohort tracking, sampling methodology, fielding timelines, and case-mix adjustment specifications.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to version, test, and deploy models using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and virtual machine (VM) environments.

• Partner with clinical, care management, complex case management, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure HOS-related data outputs and interventions align with CMS guidance.

• Build dashboards tracking measure-level HOS performance against Star Rating cut points and prior-year trend for each composite.

• Help standardize definitions, documentation logic, and reporting workflows to scale HOS analytics enterprise-wide.

title: Director of Manufacturing Strategy
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of Manufacturing Strategy to join our team. 

Position Description

The Director of Manufacturing Strategy will define and continuously refine how Oklo converts ambitious product and deployment plans into an executable manufacturing system. Reporting to the Head of Supply Chain, this leader will integrate engineering judgment, supplier-market intelligence, commercial inputs, and strategic analysis to help Oklo achieve aggressive lead-time, cost, quality, and scalability goals.

During Oklo's first-of-a-kind (FOAK) build, the Director will work directly with Responsible Engineers and suppliers to develop and improve component-level manufacturing strategies, resolve industrialization challenges, and assess whether supplier processes can produce conforming hardware at the required rate. The role will translate these findings into company-wide make-vs-buy recommendations and manufacturing roadmaps.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial strategy role. It requires enough manufacturing depth to evaluate processes, tooling, qualification needs, quality controls, production constraints, and recovery plans, as well as enough commercial fluency to compare market options and support scenario modeling. The role partners closely with Engineering, Procurement, Strategy, Quality, Program Management, and Oklo's internal fabrication leadership.

This role develops the strategy for how Oklo will manufacture at scale; it does not establish, manage, or operate factories. When Oklo elects to make a product internally, execution transitions to the internal fabrication organization. Procurement retains ownership of supplier commercial strategy, sourcing, negotiations, and contracting.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Own Oklo's enterprise manufacturing strategy, connecting product and deployment plans to executable manufacturing pathways across external suppliers and internal fabrication.

• Lead cross-functional make-vs-buy analyses and recommendations using technical feasibility, supplier capability and capacity, lead time, cost, quality, schedule risk, capital requirements, intellectual property, and long-term scalability.

• Build decision frameworks and provide supply-market intelligence to the Strategy team so alternative manufacturing scenarios can be modeled with credible assumptions and sensitivities.

• Partner with Responsible Engineers during FOAK execution to define supplier manufacturing strategies, review process plans, identify manufacturability risks, and improve the likelihood of delivering conforming hardware on schedule.

• Assess suppliers' manufacturing processes, equipment, workforce, quality systems, special-process controls, qualification paths, current loading, surge capacity, and ability to meet Oklo's forecast production rates.

• Translate supplier assessments into actionable technical recommendations for Engineering and clear capability guidance for Procurement, while preserving Procurement's ownership of commercial negotiations, contracts, and supplier relationships.

• Identify critical manufacturing constraints and fragile supply-chain nodes; develop mitigation options such as alternate processes, supplier development plans, second sources, design changes, phased capacity investments, or selective insourcing.

• Support technical vetting and due diligence of potential suppliers alongside Engineering, Quality, and Procurement, including site visits, process reviews, readiness assessments, and production-rate validation.

• Develop industrialization and manufacturing-readiness roadmaps that bridge FOAK builds to repeatable production, including learning-curve assumptions, yield and throughput improvement, tooling, automation, qualification, and capacity ramps.

• Establish and track manufacturing-strategy metrics and decision milestones related to lead time, cost, quality, capacity, scalability, risk retirement, and make-vs-buy outcome

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Зараз ми в пошуку Спеціаліста з кадрового обліку, який/яка стане надійною опорою для бізнесу й команди, відповідатиме за кадрову документацію та процеси.

Які виклики чекають на тебе в ролі:

- Організація та ведення кадрової документації на всіх етапах життєвого циклу працівника: прийняття, переведення, звільнення, зміна умов праці, відрядження.

- Підготовка довідок, супровідних листів та інших кадрових документів.

- Формування і ведення особових справ працівників.

- Участь у розробці та впровадженні внутрішніх політик, правил, посадових інструкцій.

- Участь у розробці документів щодо винагород та заохочень.

- Участь у складанні кадрової звітності.

- Своєчасне внесення інформації щодо кадрових змін до HR-систем та формування звітів.

- Підтримка ведення військового обліку.

- Взаємодія з Finance, HR та іншими командами.

Інструменти, з якими ти працюватимеш:

- Excel / Google Sheets;

- PeopleForce, HiBob, 1С, BAS;

Що для нас важливо:

- Досвід роботи в кадровому діловодстві від 3 років;

- Знання основ трудового законодавства України, вміння застосовувати їх на практиці;

- Уважність до деталей, точність у роботі з даними та документами;

- Навички роботи з великим обсягом документів та системного обліку;

- Бажання навчатись, розвиватись і брати участь у вдосконаленні кадрових процесів.

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід ведення військового обліку;

- Знання HR-систем або досвід участі в автоматизації кадрових процесів;

- Досвід взаємодії з держорганами (ПФУ, ТЦК, ДПС тощо).

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві.

title: Scientist R&D – Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a highly motivated Scientist, R&D - Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology to join the Oncology Product Development team. This role will focus on the development, optimization, verification, and validation of IHC and tissue-based workflows supporting oncology products and clinical assay development.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in IHC assay development and optimization, supported by a solid foundation in histology and FFPE tissue workflows. Experience with automated IHC/ISH staining platforms, particularly the Roche BenchMark ULTRA IHC/ISH System, is highly desirable. Experience with NGS and molecular biology workflows is an additional plus.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design and execute development, optimization, verification, and validation studies for IHC, histology, and tissue-based workflows.

• Develop and optimize IHC assays, including antibody selection and titration, antigen retrieval, staining conditions, controls, and assay performance assessment.

• Evaluate and optimize histology and pre-analytical variables, including tissue fixation, FFPE processing, embedding, sectioning, H&E staining, and slide preparation.

• Develop and troubleshoot workflows on automated IHC/ISH staining platforms and investigate staining artifacts, reagent performance, tissue quality, and assay variability.

• Plan and execute moderate- to high-complexity experiments; analyze and interpret results using tools such as Excel, JMP, and image-analysis approaches.

• Collaborate with Pathology, Clinical Laboratory Operations, Quality, Automation, and other cross-functional teams to transfer R&D methods into robust clinical laboratory workflows.

• Author study protocols, development/validation reports, SOPs, and transfer documentation, and provide technical guidance and training during implementation.

• Communicate project progress, experimental findings, risks, and recommendations to project teams and stakeholders.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Ph.D. in Pathology, Cancer Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant industry experience; or a Master's degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience; or a Bachelor's degree with a 6-8+ years of relevant industry experience.

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Strong hands-on expertise in IHC assay development, optimization, and troubleshooting, with solid knowledge of histology and FFPE tissue workflows.

• Experience with antibody characterization/titration, antigen retrieval, staining optimization, controls, tissue morphology, and assay performance evaluation.

• Experience with automated IHC/ISH platforms is highly preferred; hands-on experience with the Roche BenchMark ULTRA IHC/ISH System is a strong plus.

• Experience with H&E staining, microtomy/tissue sectioning, microscopy, digital pathology, or image analysis is desirable.

• NGS and molecular biology experience is a plus, particularly with FFPE nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, NGS library preparation, or hybrid capture workflows.

• Experience with assay development and validation in a regulated clinical laboratory, molecular diagnostics, or LDT environment is preferred.

• Ability to independently design and execute experiments, interpret data, troubleshoot technical challenges, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong technical writing, communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced R&D environment.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Planning team is seeking a Manager of Demand & Supply Planning, Counter Intrusion to join our team. The Planning team is responsible for planning material and builds to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, mobile ground equipment, and flight vehicles. The Manager of Demand & Supply Planning will manage a team of Demand & Supply Planners in executing S&OP and providing in-depth analysis for our business partners. They will ultimately be responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build for each of the supported product lines. The addition of this role is pivotal in transforming our Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process, empowering our operations to not only meet but exceed our financial objectives. This strategic hire will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and enhancing our ability to forecast, plan, and execute with greater precision and efficiency.

The right person for this role has demonstrated ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop and execute supply & demand plans that support the company's sales forecasts and business strategies

• Lead the Supply & Demand planning team to ensure efficient and effective execution of planning activities

• Collaborate through S&OP with various departments, including sales, operations, and finance, to gather relevant data for accurate supply forecasting

• Effectively distill and communicate complex scenarios to executives for strategic decision-making and alignment

• Manage inventory levels to meet service level targets while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory

• Monitor supplier performance, ensuring timely delivery of materials, and address any supply chain disruptions proactively

• Optimize supply & demand planning processes through continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency

• Implement and maintain planning systems and tools to improve planning accuracy and visibility across the organization

• Define Key Performance metrics for Supply & Demand Planning functions

• Prepare and present regular reports on program performance, including inventory metrics and risk assessments

title: Director, Rare Disease Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
description:
Position Overview

 

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market. Rare disease diagnostics is a market where the standard playbook doesn't apply: the ordering audience is specialized, the diagnostic odyssey is long, and every clinician interaction has to count.

 

This leader owns the work that turns strategy into field results: how our value is told, what the sales team carries into the room, how well the field is trained, and how quickly a new account moves from first conversation to routine ordering. You will partner closely with the marketing leader who owns clinical community engagement (KOLs, conferences, and speaker programs), and with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and corporate Commercial Operations, to ensure a single, integrated go-to-market plan.

 

The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset, and is equally comfortable in a messaging workshop, a field ride-along, and a funnel dashboard. As the business scales, this role is expected to grow into a team.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Marketing & Messaging

• Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and the core messaging framework for Zenith, translating complex genomic science into clear value propositions for clinicians, genetic counselors, and health systems.

• Collateral & Content: Lead development of sales and customer-facing assets (brochures, leave-behinds, clinical summaries, sell sheets, digital content), including the claims library and MLR / compliance review workflow.

• Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a current view of the rare disease genomics landscape and equip the field with differentiated, evidence-based positioning.

• Evidence Integration: Work with Medical and Clinical teams to convert new publications, real-world data, and utilization insights into messaging and field tools.

• Launch Support: Own the product marketing workstream of the Zenith launch plan, including launch messaging, asset readiness, and field communications.

 

Sales Enablement & Customer Adoption

• Field Enablement: Design and run onboarding, training, and ongoing education for the sales team on the science, the competitive landscape, and the value story; equip reps to be credible with geneticists and specialists.

• Customer Adoption Journey: Map and continuously improve the path from first call to routine ordering, including implementation, EMR integration touchpoints, and utilization resources, to shorten time to adoption.

• Sales Interface: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner to Sales leadership; run regular field feedback loops and translate what reps and customers are telling us into messaging, tools, and priorities.

• Market Access Pull-Through: Partner with Market Access and Reimbursement to convert coverage and payer developments into field-ready tools and messaging.

 

Commercial Insights & Targeting

• Segmentation & Targeting: Partner with Sales and corporate analytics to define customer segments and account prioritization using clinical, claims, and market data; inform target lists and field focus.

• Performance Tracking: Define the KPIs that track funnel health, ordering behavior, and adoption for the BU, and use insights to adjust messaging, enablement, and resource focus.

• Sales Operations Liaison: Represent the Rare Disease BU's needs to corporate Commercial Operations (CRM, reporting, forecasting, and ordering workflow) and ensure the field has clean data and low-friction processes.

 

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Integrated Planning: Partner with the clinical community marketing lead (KOL, conferences, speaker programs) so that field events, thought-leader engagement, and product messaging operate as one plan.

• Matrix Collaboration: Serve as the commercial connective tissue across Sales

You'll design for products that tens of thousands of restaurants, cafés, and hospitality businesses rely on every single day to run their operations - where a confusing flow isn't an inconvenience, it's a queue at the door, a missed order, or a service team under pressure. Design at this scale is a different sport: every improvement lands with enormous reach, and every decision has to earn the trust of people whose livelihoods run through our software.

Own end-to-end design for core Hospitality experiences - from problem framing through polished, shipped product - and be accountable for their quality and outcomes.

title: Brand Designer
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help shape how SpaceXAI shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built brand systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You’ll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXAI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help shape both the brand system itself and how it comes to life in our campaigns.

This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you’ll spend real time designing and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you’ll lead projects from first concept through final execution, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand evolves.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Brand system: Evolve and extend the visual identity (logo, typography, color, layout, imagery, and graphic language) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring design work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand work without you in the room.

- Campaigns: Concept and design campaigns end to end, from first idea through final production, across key visuals, launch assets, web, social, paid, out-of-home, and print.

- Creative direction: Direct agencies and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you’d set yourself.

- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a brand point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 6+ years of brand design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

- Fluency in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

- A portfolio that shows both brand system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if it includes tools or workflows you built.

- Sharp typography, layout, and art direction instincts.

- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

- Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.

- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building or relaunching a brand identity at a fast-growing tech company.

- Motion sensibility, enough to design with motion in mind and direct motion designers.

- Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

- koordinovat práci lidí během směny a rozdělovat je podle aktuální potřeby,

- hlídat plynulý chod jednotlivých částí skladu,

- reagovat na změny a řešit operativní situace,

- spolupracovat s příjmem, expedicí a dalšími částmi provozu,

- sledovat provozní čísla a podle nich rozhodovat, co je potřeba změnit,

- hledat cesty, jak práci v novém skladu dělat jednodušeji a efektivněji.

Postupně poznáš celý proces - od příjezdu zboží až po chvíli, kdy hotový nákup přebírá kurýr a vyráží k zákazníkovi.

👀 Koho hledáme?

Hlavně člověka, který si umí poradit v provozu a s lidmi.

Bude se ti u nás dařit, pokud:

- dokážeš rychle reagovat a rozhodnout se,

- umíš si zachovat přehled, i když se děje několik věcí najednou,

- dovedeš lidi zorganizovat a jasně říct, co je potřeba,

- jsi férový/á, ale zároveň se nebojíš převzít odpovědnost,

- zvládneš pracovat s čísly a převést je do konkrétního rozhodnutí,

- místo věty „takhle se to vždycky dělalo“ raději přemýšlíš, jak by to šlo udělat lépe.

Zkušenost ze skladu nebo logistiky je výhodou, ale není podmínkou. Zajímavá pro nás může být i zkušenost z výroby, retailu, gastronomie nebo jiného rychlého provozu, kde jsi koordinoval/a lidi a musel/a operativně řešit, co přinesl den.

⏰ Jak se pracuje?

Pracujeme v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12hodinové směny.

A důležitá věc: tohle není vedoucí pozice od počítače. Většinu směny strávíš přímo v provozu mezi lidmi. Potřebujeme, abys věděl/a, co se ve skladu skutečně děje.

🥐 Co od nás dostaneš?

Kromě možnosti být u otevření úplně nového skladu Rohlíku nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma a 10% cashback v kreditech na další nákupy,

- možnost placeného volna pro odpočinek a regeneraci,

- dotované obědy,

- kávu, čerstvé ovoce a další občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma,

- 86 Kč na ošatné za každou odpracovanou směnu,

- odměny za pochvaly od kolegů, které můžeš proměnit například za vouchery do Alzy nebo Notina,

- příspěvek na Multisport kartu,

- firemní akce a společné oslavy úspěchů.

💚 Nový sklad. Nový tým. A příležitost být u toho od začátku.

Nový sklad se otevírá jen jednou.

V Opatovicích budeš nastupovat ve chvíli, kdy se tým teprve skládá a celý provoz dostává svoji podobu. Nebudeš tedy jen přebírat něco, co nastavil někdo před tebou - můžeš být mezi lidmi, kteří ovlivní, jak bude sklad fungovat další roky.

A než nový sklad naplno spustíme, ukážeme ti také naše fungující robotické sklady v Praze, abys viděl/a celý provoz Rohlíku v praxi.

Zní ti to zajímavě? Ozvi se.

Nemusíš nám psát dlouhý motivační dopis. Pošli nám svůj profil nebo CV a pojďme si krátce zavolat. Třeba právě s tebou nový sklad v Opatovicích rozjedeme.

ABOUT US

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

- Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating transportation requests, assigning trips to drivers, monitoring journeys in real time, and ensuring that members arrive at their destinations safely and on time. • Confirm trip readiness, eligibility, and required authorisations in line with company procedures.

• Identify missing information or scheduling conflicts before trips are assigned.

Driver Coordination

• Resolve service concerns professionally while prioritising member safety and continuity of service.

• Record delays, cancellations, incidents, and service-related issues.

• Maintain complete trip notes and required compliance documentation.

• Ensure records are accurate, up to date, and aligned with company procedures.

• Escalate urgent or complex issues to the appropriate team members or management.

• Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

• Willingness to work US business hours consistently.

Preferred Experience

• Experience with non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) operations.

• Familiarity with healthcare scheduling and patient transportation coord

We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to work on LangSmith, our commercial AI observability and evals platform product. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build new features and functionality for the platform while working close enterprise customers, developer end-users and internal stakeholders.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop and implement key product features working across our entire Go, Python, and Typescript stack

- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to iterate on new features and enhance the product roadmap

- Drive aggressive project timelines while ensuring high engineering standards are being met by writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code

HOW TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

- 2+ years of experience in software engineering working on complex platform products

- Fullstack engineering experience with Go or Python on the backend and React + Typescript on the frontend

- Solid understanding of database systems, particularly Postgres and Redis

- Experience designing and scaling APIs, preferably in high-performance, data-intensive applications

- Strong ownership and a “get stuff done” mindset - comfortable shipping fast and iterating based on user feedback

- Strong communicator with the ability to collaborate closely with various internal stakeholders and engage directly with our top-tier customers

- Bonus: Experience with AI/LLM-powered applications, developer tools, or observability platforms

Compensation
Annual salary range: $145,000-180,000 USD

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.
